    About this item

    • EXTRA LONG MEN RAINCOAT: This rain coat clothing length is 126cm. It is recommended to be used by men whose height range from 170-180cm. Extra long hem to protect against snowfall on foot in Kashmir. With its extra-long coverage and durable construction, this raincoat combines comfort and functionality to meet your outdoor needs while ensuring the best fit for optimal performance and protection.
    • FULL-BODY WATERPROOF PROTECTION: Stay dry even in heavy downpours with this long raincoat made from premium waterproof Oxford cloth and a PVC coating. Its full-length design offers complete coverage from head to toe, making it a reliable choice for tough weather conditions. Ideal for outdoor enthusiasts, it keeps you comfortable and dry on rainy days.
    • WIND-RESISTANT DESIGN: 360° wide-brimmed hood with triple-layer storm flap + 2-way drawstrings prevents face/neck leakage. Tested in 60km/h winds - perfect for Goa bike tours, Darjeeling hill stations & coastal areas.
    • LIGHTWEIGHT & TRAVEL-FRIENDLY: Designed with convenience in mind, this raincoat is lightweight, easy to put on or take off, and folds down small for effortless storage. Whether youre heading to work, hiking, or traveling, you'll always be prepared for sudden rain without extra bulk. Carry it in your backpack and stay ready for unpredictable weather anytime!
    • SUITABLE FOR OUTDOOR RAIN COAT: Enjoy maximum freedom of movement with its wide, loose hemperfect for hiking, cycling, camping, or any outdoor activities. This raincoat ensures you stay mobile without compromising on protection or comfort. Whether you're exploring rugged terrains or commuting, wear it and move comfortably through every adventure.
